uncited: Epipolar sampling is a class of techniques that place sample points along epipolar lines to exploit geometric smoothness and reduce computation.
The method varies significantly depending on the application domain.
The following describes the two primary implementations found in the sources.
- Projected position of the light source on the screen $(L_x, L_y)$.
- Ins scattered light intensity for each screen pixel.
**Epipolar Line Generation:** Determine the entry point $E$ as the projected light position on the screen.
